description: Assembly routines for interrupt management on IA-32 architecture, including interrupt entry, spurious interrupt handling, and dynamic IRQ stub creation.

methods.name: _interrupt_enter
methods.description: Assembly routine invoked when entering an interrupt, handling stack switching, register saving, and calling the interrupt handler.

methods.name: z_SpuriousIntNoErrCodeHandler
methods.description: Assembly stub for handling spurious interrupts with no error code.

methods.name: z_SpuriousIntHandler
methods.description: Assembly stub for handling spurious interrupts, saving register state, and invoking the fatal IRQ handler.

methods.name: _irq_sw_handler
methods.description: Assembly stub for IRQ software handler, used for IRQ offloading.
